verdict: MRVL +32% on Jensen Huang Computex endorsement is the week's top catalyst; AVGO Q3 AI guide miss sparked MU -21% air pocket — watch June 24 Micron print to resolve bull/bear.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments — last 24–72h (Jun 8–11; key events from Jun 2–7 noted)

**Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing:** No new QoQ print this window. TrendForce (Jun 2) confirmed Q1-2026 DRAM industry revenue **+81% QoQ**; separate report flags HBM 2027 contract prices expected to surge **"multiples higher"** as capacity allocation tightens. Q2 conventional DRAM guide +58–63% QoQ stands. Next print: Micron fiscal Q3 (Jun 24).

**Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp:** SK Hynix quietly **delayed HBM4 ramp from Q2 → Q3-2026**. TrendForce research note (~Jun 9) flags HBM 2027 contract talks "stalled" amid pricing disputes. Micron high-yield ramp confirmed on track.

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler Capex:** **Intel +11.2%** on Jun 9 after Alphabet AI chip order — supply diversification signal, hyperscaler spend continuing. Combined 2026 capex ~$750B; **no guide-DOWN** from any hyperscaler.

**Signal 4 — AMD/Custom ASIC:** No fresh news this window. MI400/Helios on track 2H-2026. Broadcom's mixed Q3 guide is a mild caution signal on custom-ASIC economics near-term.

**Signal 5 — Optical:** **CRDO +9%, ALAB +3.2%** on Jun 9 (optical/connectivity rebound). InP supply gap ~70%; lead times 18–24 months. No new CPO penetration data.

**Signal 6 — Solar:** **FSLR -5.6%, ARRY -6.1%, NXT -5.5%** on Jun 9 — Iran shot down US Apache helicopter over Strait of Hormuz triggering geopolitical risk-off. Section 232 tariff decision expected mid-to-late June — a potential re-rating catalyst for FSLR (US domestic manufacturer).

**Signal 7 — Watchlist:** See below.

---

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| MRVL | **+32%** Jun 2 → **-6.2%** Jun 10 | Jensen Huang declared MRVL "next trillion-dollar company" at Computex stage (Jun 2); NVIDIA $2B strategic investment. Jun 10 giveback = sector risk-off |
| MU | **-21%** over Jun 4–5 | AVGO Q3 AI guide $16B vs $17.2B est. ignited HBM demand fears; DRAM ETF -20% in 2 days. Q3 earnings Jun 24 = next reset |
| AVGO | **-3%** post-earnings Jun 3 | Q2 AI revenue $10.8B (+143% YoY) beat; Q3 AI guide $16B vs street $17.2B; CEO flagged Google may use multiple chip suppliers |
| CRDO | **+9%** Jun 9 | Optical/connectivity demand; AI infra rebound; Anthropic IPO spillover |
| ALAB | **+3.2%** Jun 9 | AI infra/optical rebound |
| FSLR | **-5.6%** Jun 9 | Iran/Hormuz geopolitical risk-off |
| ARRY | **-6.1%** Jun 9 | Same geopolitical event |
| NXT | **-5.5%** Jun 9 | Same geopolitical event |
| HIVE | Analyst upgrades | FY2026 revenue $297.8M (+158% YoY); BUZZ HPC ARR $35M; first NVIDIA B200 cluster live; 320 MW AI gigafactory announced |
| INTL | **+11.2%** Jun 9 | Alphabet AI chip order (hyperscaler diversification) |

---

## Context vs Baseline

- **MRVL:** Thesis-confirming. NVIDIA endorsement + $2B investment validates the networking-silicon bottleneck story ahead of schedule.
- **AVGO guide miss:** $16B Q3 AI guide is still +200% YoY — the "miss" is vs perfection-priced expectations, not vs fundamentals. But the Google multi-supplier comment is a real watch item for MRVL/custom-ASIC design-win durability.
- **HBM pricing near-term:** AVGO-triggered fear created a MU -21% air pocket; June 24 Micron print decides whether this was noise or a real inflection.
- **Correction-risk signal (baseline):** SK Hynix HBM4 ramp slipping to Q3, three-supplier capacity surge late 2026 — correction risk thesis still on track. TrendForce 2027 price surge view is contrarian-bullish but rests on supply staying constrained.
- **HIVE:** BUZZ becoming real ($35M ARR, B200 live). Speculative; still BTC-correlated. 320 MW gigafactory is ambition, not reality yet.

---

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| DRAM/HBM pricing (2026) | Decelerating near-term fear | Bear near-term |
| HBM 2027 pricing | Surge expected (TrendForce) | Bull 2027 |
| Hyperscaler capex | Intact, no cuts | Bull |
| Custom silicon / MRVL | Accelerating, NVIDIA-confirmed | Bull |
| Optical / CRDO / ALAB | Supply-demand gap persists | Bull |
| Solar (near-term) | Geopolitical headwind | Bear near-term |
| Late-2026 HBM capacity ramp | On track for overcapacity | Bear on correction risk |

---

## Most Important Development

**MRVL +32% on Jensen Huang's Computex "trillion-dollar" call (Jun 2)** is the clearest watchlist catalyst of the week — NVIDIA CEO making an explicit, named endorsement from the industry's top stage, backed by a $2B investment. This directly validates the AI networking bottleneck thesis. The Jun 10 -6.2% giveback is normal mean-reversion after a single-session +32% move.

**Close second:** AVGO Q3 guide miss ($16B vs $17.2B) → MU -21% air pocket. Watch Jun 24 Micron Q3 print as the thesis stress test: if HBM pricing and 2H demand holds, this week's fear was the buy. If guidance softens, correction-risk signal moves from watch to flash.
